thread:
vikram: Heads-up — APAC pilot customer signed a Q4 dedicated commit. Sales proposes 18 H100s reserved in SIN with a requested 40% burst headroom for Black Friday week. Can infra confirm feasibility and constraints?

ashley: Quick flag — our SIN H100 inventory is currently 12 active in dedicated pools and ~8 more are scheduled but not guaranteed until mid-Nov. Also running close to egress quotas per AZ. :thinking_face: 

jon: What are the expected GPU-hours/day from Sales? They sent an estimate but it's fuzzy.

emily: From the deck: baseline traffic shape says ~10k requests/sec peak, avg request ~800 tokens, peak window ~6 hours/day on heavy days. Using our perf profiling for Model X: ~1.2M tokens/hour per H100 at our batching defaults.

lia: Quick calc pasted: 
```
# rough peak gpus calc
peak_tokens_per_hr = 10_000 * 3600  # = 36,000,000 tokens/hr
gpu_tokens_per_hr = 1_200_000
required_gpus = ceil(36_000_000 / 1_200_000) = 30 gpus
```
So raw peak needs ~30 H100s before caching/quantization. That exceeds the 18 commit.

vikram: So Sales' 18 H100 commit won't cover peak unless we rely on cross-region burst or hosted fallback. Options: bump commit, allow cross-region burst (SG -> JP), autoscale to hosted for overflow, or tune model/clients (kv-prefix caching, quant). What about buffer policy?

jon: Standard buffer policy is 25% on top of commit to avoid SLA slips. For episodic events like BF we can grant a temporary 50% buffer for a defined week. That would make effective headroom = 18 * 1.5 = 27 H100 equivalent. Still shy of 30 but closer.

emily: Operational constraints: we cannot legally spin up 9 extra H100s in SIN within 24 hours due to quota & procurement lead time. Cross-region burst to JP is feasible for single-GPU serving, but not for multi-GPU model-parallel (NVLink). Also cross-region increases latency — need customer sign-off.

lia: Alternative is mixing instance types: some peak work can run on A10/A40 nodes if memory fits. They're more available in SIN. Trade-off is throughput per card and model compatibility.

vikram: Can infra run a quick capacity sim across pools (dedicated-sg-h100:12, dedicated-jp-h100:8, warm-a10-sg:6) with policies: allow JP burst for single-gpu only, enable hosted fallback beyond reserved? Need output: minimal reserved H100 in SG to meet SLO with 50% BF and hosted fallback allowed.

capacity-bot: Scheduled capacity simulation job queued. run-id=cap-sim-20260312-01. ETA ~30m, will post summary.

jon: Pricing note for Sales: commit vs on-demand delta gives customer ~25-35% savings per gpu-hr. If they accept a temporary increase to 27 H100 for the week we can show incremental cost and savings vs pure on-demand overflow. I'll prepare numbers.

ashley: Network question: can we temporarily raise SIN egress quota for Black Friday week? @networking-team need to confirm. Also watch AZ distribution so we don't single-point pool.

vikram: @jon can you ask Sales to confirm whether their model uses model-parallel (NVLink) or is single-GPU? If model-parallel, cross-region burst is not an option. Also ask about willingness to enable prefix caching and tolerate quantized model for some endpoints.

jon: will confirm with customer. I'll ask three things: NVLink/multi-gpu requirement, tolerance for cross-region routing, and caching toggle.

emily: Ops tweak suggestion for BF week: reduce autoscaler cooldown to 60s, increase max-batch to 64, and pre-stage warm A10s to reduce cold-starts. Those changes increase throughput but need monitoring.

lia: TL;DR suggested plan: 1) Propose temporary BF week buffer = +50% (27 H100 equiv). 2) Allow cross-region JP burst for single-GPU workloads. 3) Pre-stage 6 A10 warm nodes in SIN. 4) Enable hosted fallback for overflow. 5) Sales to return pricing delta and model-parallel confirmation. 6) Ops to adjust autoscaler settings.

vikram: Agreed. Next actions: capacity-bot will post sim; @jon sales to get NVLink/caching answers; @ashley network to check egress & AZ quotas; ops to pre-stage A10s and adjust autoscaler. Revisit in 24h. :thumbsup:
